text:
Clara Wu: Quick flag — Orbitware (midmarket) hit our 55% decline rule. Trial expires in 10 days. I want to try a low-pressure 'restore & check-in' flow (not an aggressive save).

Devon Hart: context? last contact? what dropped?

Clara Wu: last contact 2 weeks ago. They did initial setup but stopped after an error in the webhook connector. Health 70 -> 30. Billing not configured.

Megan Ortiz: 30 is borderline. I like low-pressure. Outline steps?

Clara Wu: Plan: 1) Offer a 21-day read-only restore of last known-good workspace (no billing changes). 2) 25-min technician check-in to rewire webhook and run one sample workflow. 3) 1,500 token trial credit + priority chat for 7 days. 4) Capture a one-question reason poll in-session (Webhook / Data / Time / Pricing / Other). 5) Events: `restore_activated`, `webhook_fixed`, `first_workflow_run`.

Devon Hart: can the portal trigger the restore with a single reply? we should avoid manual ops.

Megan Ortiz: product supports a "restore_snapshot" flag. I can wire a reply-to-email hook that flips it. Also will add a Calendly slot on the confirmation.

Clara Wu: draft outreach text: 
```
Hi {{first_name}},\nWe noticed activity dropped and can restore your workspace to the last working snapshot for 21 days while we help fix the webhook. No billing changes required. Book a 25-min tech check here: {{calendly_link}} or reply "RESTORE" to accept. We'll also grant a 1,500 token credit to validate the fix.\n```

Billing Ops: confirm token provisioning for playbook?

Billing Ops: approved up to 2000 tokens per play. We'll automate grants via the playbook claim flow.

cs-automations-bot: Action: create_play 'restore_checkin_flow' -> assignee Megan Ortiz.

Megan Ortiz: I'll add the Calendly, hook reply "RESTORE" -> portal flag, and attach a tiny GIF for webhook troubleshooting. Will push email template to playbook doc.

Devon Hart: instrumentation: please emit `restore_activated`, `webhook_fixed`, `workflow_success` with account id so CS dashboard can roll up. If `workflow_success` fires, auto-schedule a 1:1 health call within 48h.

Megan Ortiz: will add those events and a cohort card for "restore_trials".

Clara Wu: cadence: outreach now, 48h lab window, reminder at day 7, 3-day pre-restore-expiry alert. If no reply in 72h, fallback: short nudge + offer a one-click pause instead.

Devon Hart: checklist before send: email template (Megan), Calendly + GIF (Megan), reply->flag tested (Product), credit flow (Billing Ops), events wired (Devon), outreach (Clara).

Clara Wu: sending outreach now. Will update with booking/outcome. :sparkles: 

Megan Ortiz: update 1777777920 — Orbitware accepted restore and booked tech check Fri 9am. Running the flow and will post results here.
